question: Who is the author of the book '2024: The Election that Surprised India'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajdeep Sardesai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rajdeep Sardesai is a renowned Indian news anchor and author.
 
• The book "2024: The Election that Surprised India" is his analysis of the 2024 Indian general elections.
 
• He has previously authored books like "2014: The Election that Changed India" and "Newsman: Tracking India in the Modi Era".
 
• Rajdeep Sardesai is known for his in-depth political analysis and journalistic expertise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Book Overview**

 
 
• The book provides a comprehensive analysis of the political climate leading up to and during the 2024 elections in India.
 
• It explores the key players, strategies, and unexpected outcomes that defined the election.
 
 
 
• **Rajdeep Sardesai's Career**
 
 
• He has worked with leading news channels like NDTV, CNN-IBN, and India Today.
 
• He is a recipient of numerous awards, including the Padma Shri in 2008.
 
 
 
• **Context of the 2024 Elections**
 
 
• The 2024 Indian general elections are a pivotal moment in Indian politics, shaping the future of governance and policy.
 
• The book delves into the social, economic, and political factors influencing voter behavior.
 
 
 
• **Impact of the Book**
 
 
• The book aims to provide readers with a deeper understanding of the complexities of Indian politics.
 
• It is a valuable resource for scholars, political enthusiasts, and anyone interested in contemporary Indian history.
